name: The Four Seasons Gallery
description: Walk a museum of four seasons: each wing plays its Vivaldi concerto, hangs five paintings and is full of things to play with, by day or by night.

store.tagline: Walk a museum of the four seasons, each wing playing its Vivaldi concerto.
store.description:
The Four Seasons Gallery is a walk-through 3D museum for phone and desktop, made in Game Studio on Möbius.

A domed rotunda opens onto four wings: Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter. Each wing plays its concerto from Vivaldi's Four Seasons, hangs five public-domain paintings (Botticelli, Arcimboldo, Bruegel, Monet, Van Gogh, Seurat, Levitan, Klimt, Avercamp) and looks out through a great window onto its own 3D landscape.

Things to play with
- Shake the blossom tree and the maple, make the fountain leap and the orrery's planets race
- Kick beach balls and apples, scatter leaf piles, watch a summer storm with lightning and thunder
- Make the skaters jump and spin, ring the ice chandelier, shake the music-box snow globe
- Pull the brass lever to turn day into night: candlelit galleries, stars and northern lights, fireflies and a harvest bonfire, and each wing switches to its slow night movement

Controls: WASD and the mouse on a computer; on a phone the left thumb walks and the right thumb looks; tap things to play with them.

Music: Vivaldi, The Four Seasons, performed by John Harrison with the Wichita State University Chamber Players (CC BY-SA 4.0). Full credits in CREDITS.md.
